a.text: Being upfront about a change to our plan: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 before taking means we both almost certainly die (about 4% chance we get there). The reserve has exactly 4 now, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. I'm going to take 4 this round, and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. Please don't take this round too. If we both take, a random split likely leaves us both short. After that I'll take nothing more and will operate every round to rebuild the reserve for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.
